The *Dassanenapahātabbaduka* is a textual unit within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Following the analytical framework of the Abhidhamma *mātikā*, the section investigates conditional relations involving dhammas that are to be abandoned by vision (*dassanena pahātabba*) and those that are not. No direct secondary studies or discussions specific to this section of the *Paṭṭhāna* appear in the provided reference literature, where mentions of the title instead reference the corresponding dyad in the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.
